pythonFunction.name: validate_authentication_pin
pythonFunction.description: Validates the 4-digit security PIN captured from native phone keypad input. If the PIN is invalid or consists of repeated digits (like 0000, 1111, 2222, etc.), returns auth_status 'Fail' and decrements attempts_remaining (starts at 3, decrements to 2, 1, 0). If valid, returns auth_status 'Pass'.
